touches.text: Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed. [Q#87: The hollow proof's live tooth (ticket ce92eb562cf9 clause 6) reads 6890cf7e4053's clause-2 tooth in hunk mode. That tooth was deleted with the inference_calls table (98ab0e9db57f), so the clause has no subject and reds forever (measured 2026-11-11). No other live reading has ever used hunk mode, so there is nothing to repoint it at, and fixture teeth 1-5 still cover hunk mode. Does clause 6 retire with its subject, as c691's clause 1 did with cairnmap? CC's read: retire it.]
